# FX spot rate (`fx-spot` v1)

Spot rate for a currency pair with bid/ask.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `FX` · **Identifiers:** `FX-…` in `pair`

Open one with `FX <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: fx-spot
version: 1
description: Spot rate for a currency pair with bid/ask.
match: { kind: fx-spot, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · FX spot rate, id: $.pair }
strip:
  - { label: Pair, bind: $.pair }
  - { label: Mid, bind: $.mid, fmt: rate5, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Bid, bind: $.bid, fmt: rate5 }
  - { label: Ask, bind: $.ask, fmt: rate5 }
  - { label: "1D change", bind: $.change1d, fmt: pct2, tone: sign }
  - { label: Value date, bind: $.spotDate, fmt: date }
panels:
  - id: history
    kind: line
    title: Last 30 days
    key: F2
    rows: $.history
    x: date
    y: mid
    fmt: rate5
  - id: pair
    kind: kv
    title: Conventions
    area: right
    rows: $.conventions
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.fxForwardCurve, 'fx-forward-curve')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
